note: Every image or video file in public/, src/assets/ and assets/ must be listed here with a reason, or be a captured showcase slot file (src/data/capture-slots.json). scripts/check-capture-slots.mjs enforces this so a product screenshot, concept render or mock-up cannot come back unnoticed. Product captures belong in the capture slots only.

categories.brand: Logo, favicon and wordmark: identity, not a showcase image.
categories.brand-card: Open Graph card rendered by scripts/build-og.mjs from brand tokens and pinned product data only; never embeds a screenshot.
categories.brand-artwork: Original website identity artwork. Not a desktop capture, wallpaper or theme preview.
categories.app-logo: Third-party application logo used nominatively to name an application (src/components/AppLogo.astro).
categories.wallpaper-licensed: A licensed, credited photograph that HorneroOS ships as a wallpaper (CC BY / CC BY-SA, credit on /wallpapers). It shows a place, not the desktop.
categories.mascot: Javi sprite art rendered from the shell asset pin at build time (not stored in this repository).
categories.showcase-capture: Real HorneroOS desktop captures and walkthrough clip produced on running HorneroOS for the Apps and Welcome showcase pages.
